label: Aristotle, Physics VII.5, 250b4-7: Half an altering or growing agent may cause no alteration or…
interpretation: Half an alterer or grower may fall below the threshold for any alteration or growth, just as a smaller force may fail to move a weight. The possibility is kept over cases: in some case the halved agent produces no change. It does not assert that every halved agent fails (Codex P1 on #186).
